capabilities: Draw a family tree from a kin code block
Add and edit people, partners and children with clicks or taps
Show each person's relation to a chosen character
Track titles, reigns and the line of succession
Save the tree as a PNG or SVG picture
extras: Beta that rewrites tree text in notes; the README advises copying the vault first. No GEDCOM import or PDF export, and the author tested it only on Windows, iPhone and iPad.
problem: A fictional dynasty's family tree is hard to read and change as hand-written text, and Obsidian has no tree editor.

relations.evidence: You can also install the plugin with BRAT or by hand.

summary: Draws and edits the family tree of a fictional noble house in a note, keeping it as plain text in a kin code block.
